messages:
Maya: T-minus 45 for EU change window (22:00 UTC). Final greenlight check — risk owners, release notes, and rollback plan? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout starts at 22:45 UTC. Canary window 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Canaries on eu-west-1. Job ID: rb-7123. Status: queued.

Owen: Release notes posted: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-eu-launch :doc:

Sophie: DB migration? Last run showed slow alter on replicas — do we need a read-only window?

Maya: No schema changes this deploy. Only a config flag flip and model pin. No downtime expected.

Tiago: Model pinning: pin model redwood/opt-13b-quant@v3 to the dedicated pool for 30m during canary. Fallback plan to opt-qa-13b-v2 if p50 latency > 220ms for 2 consecutive minutes.

Akshay: Rollback criteria proposed: - error rate > 1.5% sustained for 3m - embed latency p95 > 400ms - customer-facing 5xx spike > 0.5%.

oncall: @Maya @Owen I'm on standby. If we need to rollback, prefer automated rollback via deploy-bot first, then manual unpin.

Maya: Sounds good. Confirming release note bullet re: config flip + pin. Also QA smoke script path: ./scripts/smoke/eu-launch.sh

Sophie: Running smoke now: logs look clean. Samples attached: `generation latency 140ms p50`.

Tiago: Deploy-bot, start warmup now? We should warm caches and KV layers 15m pre rollout.

deploy-bot: Warmup started on eu clusters. Warmup jobs: 4/4 healthy.

Akshay: If we hit the latency threshold, rollback command is: ```/deploy rollback rb-7123 --reason 'latency spike'``` — keep it in chat.

Maya: Final: thumbs-up from SRE? @oncall

oncall: :thumbsup: Good to go. I'll monitor dashboards and post alerts to #incidents if we trigger thresholds.

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 -> 5% traffic -> complete. Metrics: errors 0.1%, p50 150ms.

Maya: Moving to 25% in 10m unless issues. Everyone stay nearby for rollbacks.
